interface.title: GRADE certainty of evidence
interface.stage_of_work: Rating the certainty of a pooled body of evidence for each outcome, after the studies have been appraised and before the summary-of-findings table is written
interface.what_it_is_for: A reviewer enters their GRADE downgrade and upgrade judgments for one outcome and gets the overall certainty rating (very low to high), with the arithmetic shown and an option to save it as JSON.

data.note: There is no example data and nothing to upload. Every judgment is chosen by hand from dropdown lists, plus an optional free-text outcome label (I used 'all-cause mortality' and 'lung cancer incidence'). Everything runs in the browser. Two JSON files were downloaded (both named grade-certainty-assessment.json) and read back as text; no screenshot shows their contents.

features.name: Rule-based rating calculator: start level by design, minus downgrades, plus upgrades, capped
features.general: Pick a starting level from the type of evidence, take off points for each concern, add points for each strengthening factor, and map the capped total onto an ordered set of named categories, showing how the total was reached
features.specific: Body of evidence sets HIGH (4) or LOW (2); five downgrade domains (0/−1/−2) and three upgrade factors (+1/+2, +1, +1) give a Final score held between 1 and 4, shown as Very low, Low, Moderate or High certainty with a 'Starting · Downgrade · Upgrade · Final n/4' line
steps: Choose the study design (randomized starts high, non-randomized starts low)
Set each downgrading domain to 0, −1 or −2
Optionally set the upgrading factors when they are allowed
Press Calculate certainty (or Enter in the label field)
Read the category and the breakdown line; a total below 1 or above 4 is held at 1 or 4
serves_tasks: Lower confidence in randomized evidence for one or more concerns and see the resulting rating
Lower confidence in observational evidence that has its own concerns and see the resulting rating
Raise confidence in observational evidence that has no concerns, using recognised strengthening factors
Read how the rating was reached (starting level, points taken off, points added, final level) to explain or report it

features.name: Conditional enabling of follow-up options
features.general: Lock a group of follow-up inputs, and set them back to zero, unless earlier answers make them allowed, with a note saying why they are locked
features.specific: The Upgrading considerations selects are enabled only when Body of evidence is non-randomized and every downgrade is 0. Otherwise they are disabled and set to 0, and the note changes from 'Upgrading may be considered…' to 'Upgrading is unavailable for randomized evidence or evidence already downgraded.'
steps: Choose non-randomized with no downgrades: the upgrade selects unlock
Add any downgrade, or switch to randomized: the upgrades lock and go back to 0
Remove the downgrade: the upgrades unlock again, starting from 0
serves_tasks: Check that strengthening factors are locked and cleared once a concern is recorded or the evidence is randomized

features.name: Stale-result guard tied to export
features.general: When any input changes after a calculation, clear the shown result and disable export, so a saved file always matches the current inputs
features.specific: Changing any select or the design hides the Result card's rating and greys out 'Export assessment as JSON' until Calculate certainty is pressed again
steps: The result goes back to the prompt and Export is disabled
serves_tasks: Save the finished assessment as a file and check it matches the screen

features.name: Local JSON export of the assessment record
features.general: Download the computed result together with every input judgment, the method and a caution note as a structured file on the user's own machine
features.specific: Export assessment as JSON saves grade-certainty-assessment.json with outcome, study_design, starting_certainty, certainty, score, downgrade_points, upgrade_points, judgments{8 domains}, method and caution (fields checked from the file read back as text by the run and the replay; no screen shows the file)
steps: Open the downloaded file and check its fields against the Result card
serves_tasks: Save the finished assessment as a file and check it matches the screen

features.name: Form reset for comparing scenarios
features.general: Return every input and the result to defaults so another combination can be tried and compared
features.specific: Reset sets all selects to 0, the design to randomized and the label to empty, clears the Result and disables Export
steps: Enter a new design and judgments
Calculate and compare the new category with the earlier one
serves_tasks: Clear the form and start a new combination to compare categories
